topics.headline: Next US CPI YoY likely below 3.7
topics.summary: US CPI headline was 3.7% year-over-year in the reference month ending 2026-09-30. Prior month 3.4. US CPI index rose 0.6% from the prior month. US CPI food was 2.5% year-over-year in the reference month ending 2026-09-30. Prior month 2.7. US CPI shelter was 3.2% year-over-year in the reference month ending 2026-09-30. Prior month 3.0. US CPI energy was 3.8% year-over-year in the reference month ending 2026-09-30. Prior month 3.3.

evidence.point: US CPI headline was 3.7% year-over-year in the reference month ending 2026-09-30. Prior month 3.4.
US CPI index rose 0.6% from the prior month.
US CPI food was 2.5% year-over-year in the reference month ending 2026-09-30. Prior month 2.7.

US CPI energy was 3.8% year-over-year in the reference month ending 2026-09-30. Prior month 3.3.

gaps: No oil price on this feed. The energy row is the CPI energy index.
US CPI is monthly. The next print is the following month, not this week.

topics.headline: Next HICP > 3.8
topics.summary: Latest print 3.8 implies next release exceeds it given energy at 18.9 accelerating from 14.3 while services and core also rose.

evidence.point: Eurozone HICP headline was 3.8% year-over-year in the reference month ending 2026-09-30. Prior month 3.2.
Eurozone HICP energy was 18.9% year-over-year in the reference month ending 2026-09-30. Prior month 14.3.
Eurozone HICP food was 1.3% year-over-year in the reference month ending 2026-09-30. Prior month 1.1.
Eurozone HICP services was 3.2% year-over-year in the reference month ending 2026-09-30. Prior month 3.0.
Eurozone HICP core was 2.5% year-over-year in the reference month ending 2026-09-30. Prior month 2.4.

gaps: Energy here is the HICP energy index, not a Brent quote.
